models.notes: Dense 33B code model trained from scratch on 2T tokens (87% code, 10% English code-related text, 3% Chinese text; 1.8T at a 4K window, then 0.2T at 16K), 16K context, fill-in-the-middle. HumanEval 79.3 is DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 33B (paper Table 3; base 56.1; MBPP 66.0 base / 70.0 instruct). GSM8K via PAL (60.7 base) is a different protocol, so left null. Release date 2023-11-02 follows Epoch (the HF weights were uploaded 2023-11-01 UTC). Compute is Epoch's 3.96e23 (6ND). MMLU is not officially reported (Epoch's independent run: 39%). A first-party paid API at launch could not be verified, so api=false. Arena Elo is my estimate, not a measured value: the model is not in the 2025-01-05 snapshot, and I put it roughly midway between codellama-34b-instruct (1042.9) and deepseek-llm-67b-chat (1076.7), because a code-tuned instruct model chats worse than its general sibling.

Dense 67B English/Chinese model trained from scratch on 2T tokens, 4K context, SFT plus DPO chat variant. Released 2023-11-29 (HF repos and GitHub the same day; Epoch lists the 2024-01-05 paper date instead). MMLU 71.3 is the base model, 5-shot. HumanEval 73.8 and GSM8K 84.1 are the 67B Chat model (base: HumanEval 42.7, GSM8K 63.4, MATH 18.7, MBPP 57.4, BBH 68.7). Compute is Epoch's 8.04e23 (6ND). Arena Elo is measured: deepseek-llm-67b-chat in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 107 of 154). Epoch's independent GPQA Diamond run gives 25%, but that is not an official number, so gpqa is null. Whether the first-party DeepSeek API served this model at launch is not verified (the API changelog starts in May 2024), so api=false.

Fine-grained plus shared-expert MoE: 16.4B total, about 2.8B active per token, trained on 2T tokens. Uses roughly 40% of the FLOPs of LLaMA2 7B (74.4T vs 187.9T per 4K tokens) at similar scores. All scores are the base model (paper Table 3): MMLU 5-shot 45.0, GSM8K 8-shot 18.8, HumanEval 26.8, MBPP 39.2. Chat-variant scores were not verified. Date 2024-01-11 is the GitHub release and the arXiv paper 2401.06066 (HF repos were created 2024-01-08/09); Epoch also lists 2024-01-11. Compute 3.4e22 = 6 x 2.8B x 2T, which matches Epoch's figure ('Likely' confidence). Arena Elo is my estimate for a model not on the arena, placed between mistral-7b-instruct (1008.2) and llama-2-7b-chat (1036.8).

MoE with MLA attention: 236B total, 21B active, 8.1T tokens, 128K context. Weights went up on 2024-05-06 (GitHub release and HF upload) and the arXiv paper is dated 2024-05-07 (Epoch lists May 7). MMLU 78.5 is the base model. HumanEval 81.1 and GSM8K 92.2 are V2-Chat (RL); the SFT version gets 76.8 and 90.8 (base: HumanEval 48.8, GSM8K 79.2). MATH 53.9. GPQA-Diamond 35.3 is for V2-0506 from DeepSeek's own V3 report. Price is about 1 yuan input / 2 yuan output per 1M tokens, which equals $0.14 / $0.28: I could not open DeepSeek's May 2024 pricing page, but the V3 post says its promo price is 'same as V2' and secondary trackers list V2 at $0.14 / $0.28, so treat the launch price as secondary-sourced. API upgrades: V2-0517 (2024-05-17) and V2-0628 (2024-06-28, HumanEval 84.8, MATH 71.0, Arena-Hard 41.6 -> 68.3). Compute is Epoch's 1.02e24 (6 x 21B x 8.1T). Arena Elo is my estimate: the V2 chat model is not in the 2025-01-05 snapshot. I placed it between Qwen1.5-72B-Chat (1147.5) and deepseek-coder-v2 (1178.4), using Arena-Hard 41.6 and MT-Bench as guides.

MoE: 236B total, 21B active (a 16B Lite version also exists). Continued from an intermediate DeepSeek-V2 checkpoint (4.2T tokens) with 6T extra tokens (10.2T total), 128K context. HumanEval 90.2 (Instruct), MBPP+ 76.2, LiveCodeBench 43.4, Aider 73.7, MATH 75.7, GSM8K 94.9, MMLU 5-shot 79.2, Arena-Hard 65.0 (all from the paper, 2024-06-17). SWE-bench 12.7 is from the paper's Table 7; it does not say which subset or agent was used, and it predates SWE-bench Verified, so it is not a Verified score. The API 'deepseek-coder' was upgraded to Coder-V2-0614 on 2024-06-14, three days before the open-weight and paper release. Price: DeepSeek's pricing page lists deepseek-coder at $0.14 / $0.28 (as recalled and via secondary trackers; the historical page itself was not retrievable). Compute is Epoch's 1.2852e24 (6 x 21B x 10.2T, which includes the V2 base stage). Arena Elo is measured: deepseek-coder-v2 in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 66).

Merge of DeepSeek-V2-Chat-0628 and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-0724 into one model (same 236B / 21B-active MoE). The official release post and HF upload are dated 2024-09-05 (Epoch lists 2024-09-06). HumanEval (Python) 89, Arena-Hard 76.2, AlpacaEval 2.0 50.5, MT-Bench 9.02, Aider 72.2, LiveCodeBench 41.8, MMLU-Pro 65.83 (HF model card). MMLU 80.6 (chat, EM), GPQA-Diamond 41.3 and SWE-bench Verified 22.6 are for DeepSeek V2.5-0905 from DeepSeek's own V3 technical report (Table 6); there is no separate base release, and no official GSM8K score exists. The API price is the standard deepseek-chat rate of $0.14 / $0.28 as listed by third-party pages. The follow-up V2.5-1210 (2024-12-10) lifted MATH-500 from 74.8 to 82.8 and has its own Arena Elo of 1279.1 in the same snapshot. Compute is Epoch's 1.7892e24 = 6 x 21B x 14.2T unique tokens (8.2T V2-chat lineage + 6T Coder-V2 continuation). Arena Elo is measured: deepseek-v2.5 in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 25).

First DeepSeek reasoning (o1-style) model. It was preview-only in the chat.deepseek.com web app (about 50 messages a day), with no API and no weights at launch ('Open-source models & API coming soon'); the full R1 came in January 2025. Parameters and compute were never disclosed (Epoch also lists none). Reported figures (from charts; confirmed by DeepLearning.AI): AIME 2024 52.5 (o1-preview 44.6), MATH-500 91.6 (o1-preview 85.5), Codeforces about 1450 (o1-preview 1428). It trailed o1-preview on GPQA Diamond, LiveCodeBench and ZebraLogic but no official GPQA number exists, so gpqa is null. Arena Elo is a rough guess: it was never on the text arena, so I put it near the midpoint of QwQ-32B-Preview (1153.7) and o1-mini (1306.3), below the later R1. Treat it as low confidence.

MoE: 671B total (685B on Hugging Face including 14B of multi-token-prediction weights), 37B active, 14.8T tokens, FP8 training, 2.788M H800 GPU-hours. Release post and GitHub release are dated 2024-12-26 (HF repo created 2024-12-25 UTC; Epoch lists 2024-12-24). MMLU 87.1 (5-shot), HumanEval 65.2 (0-shot, plain HumanEval) and GSM8K 89.3 (8-shot) are the BASE model, because no chat-model values exist for those; the earlier draft used 82.6, which is the chat model's HumanEval-Mul (multilingual) and a different benchmark. The chat model gets MMLU 88.5, GPQA-Diamond 59.1, SWE-bench Verified 42.0, HumanEval-Mul 82.6, MMLU-Pro 75.9, MATH-500 90.2. Price is the launch promo of $0.14 / $0.28, which the release post says is 'same as V2', valid until 2025-02-08. After that the standard price is $0.27 input (cache miss) / $1.10 output. Compute is Epoch's 3.3e24 (6 x 37B x 14.8T). Arena Elo is measured: deepseek-v3 in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 3, 1318.7; 1319.4 on 2025-01-15).

Alibaba's first open-weight LLM. Qwen-7B and Qwen-7B-Chat went up on ModelScope and Hugging Face on 2023-08-03 (Qwen GitHub changelog); the arXiv tech report is dated 2023-09-28, which Epoch uses as its date. The model was updated on 2023-09-25 (tokens 2.2T -> 2.4T, context 2K -> 8K). Scores are the updated version, so they are slightly better than what shipped on launch day: MMLU 5-shot 58.2 (base; original launch value 56.7), HumanEval 37.2 and GSM8K 8-shot 54.1 (Qwen-7B-Chat; the original chat release scored 24.4 and 41.1 0-shot; base HumanEval 29.9, GSM8K 51.7, MATH 11.6, C-Eval 63.5). Compute is Epoch's 1.01e23 (6 x 7B x 2.4T). Alibaba Cloud's API price for this size was not found, so api=false and prices are null. Arena Elo is my estimate (about 45 below Qwen-14B-Chat's measured 1035.3).

3T tokens. Released 2023-09-25 per the Qwen GitHub changelog (Epoch uses the 2023-09-28 tech report). MMLU 5-shot 66.3 is the base model. HumanEval 43.9 and GSM8K 8-shot 59.3 are Qwen-14B-Chat (base: HumanEval 32.3, GSM8K 61.3, MATH 24.8, C-Eval 72.1). Compute is Epoch's 2.5e23 (6 x 14B x 3T). Arena Elo is measured: qwen-14b-chat in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 131). A community contamination database lists Qwen-14B on GSM8K, but it is crowd-sourced rather than an independent measurement, so the contamination flag stays false. Filler entry between Qwen-7B and Qwen-72B.

72B dense, 3T tokens, 32K context, released together with Qwen-1.8B on 2023-11-30 (Qwen GitHub changelog; Epoch agrees). MMLU 5-shot 77.4 is the base model. HumanEval 64.6 and GSM8K 8-shot 75.7 (76.4 zero-shot) are Qwen-72B-Chat; base is HumanEval 35.4, GSM8K 78.9, MATH 35.2, C-Eval 83.3. Compute is Epoch's 1.3e24 (6 x 72B x 3T). API: Alibaba Cloud's own billing notice (dated 2024-03-11) shows the open-source qwen-72b-chat was already a paid DashScope model at 0.012 yuan per 1K tokens before it went to 0.02 yuan on 2024-03-18. 12 yuan per 1M tokens is about $1.69 at 7.1 CNY/USD, used for both input and output (single rate). Whether it was on sale on launch day itself is not verified. Arena Elo is my estimate: qwen-72b-chat is not in the 2025-01-05 snapshot. I put it between Qwen1.5-14B-Chat (1108.8) and Qwen1.5-32B-Chat (1125.5), below Qwen1.5-72B-Chat (1147.5), given the similar base MMLU but an older post-training recipe.

Qwen1.5 family release on 2024-02-04 (blog date): sizes 0.5B to 72B at launch (32B followed in April and 110B on 2024-04-25), 32K context for all sizes, 3T tokens. Scores are the base 72B: MMLU 5-shot 77.5, GSM8K 79.5, HumanEval 41.5, MATH 34.1, BBH 65.5, C-Eval 84.1. The 72B-Chat gets MT-Bench 8.61 and AlpacaEval 2.0 27.18. No official GPQA (Epoch's independent run gives 29%). Compute is Epoch's 1.3e24. API: Alibaba Cloud's billing notice (dated 2024-03-11) lists qwen1.5-72b-chat at 0.02 yuan per 1K tokens from 2024-03-18 (no price before that date), which is 20 yuan per 1M tokens, about $2.78 at 7.2 CNY/USD, one rate for input and output. So the price is dated six weeks after the model release. Arena Elo is measured: qwen1.5-72b-chat in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 81).

7T tokens, 128K context, GQA. Blog dated 2024-06-07. MMLU 5-shot 84.2 is the base model (base HumanEval 64.6, GSM8K 89.5, MATH 51.1, GPQA 37.9). HumanEval 86.0, GSM8K 91.1 (Qwen2 blog; the Qwen2.5 blog restates it as 93.2), GPQA 42.4, MMLU-Pro 64.4, MATH 59.7, MT-Bench 9.12 and Arena-Hard 48.1 are for Qwen2-72B-Instruct. Compute is Epoch's 3.02e24 (6 x 72B x 7T). Arena Elo is measured: qwen2-72b-instruct in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 60). First-party API price at launch not verified, so api=false.

18T tokens, 128K context. Blog dated 2024-09-19. MMLU 5-shot 86.1 is the base model (base HumanEval 59.1, GSM8K 91.5, MATH 62.1, GPQA 45.9). HumanEval 86.6, GSM8K 95.8, GPQA 49.0, MMLU-Pro 71.1, MATH 83.1, LiveCodeBench 55.5, Arena-Hard 81.2 and MT-Bench 9.35 are for Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct. Compute is Epoch's 7.8e24 (6 x 72.7B x 18T). Arena Elo is measured: qwen2.5-72b-instruct in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 26). The contamination flag is false: the public evidence is about the Qwen2.5 family in general and mostly about 7B-scale and math variants (arXiv 2507.10532 shows Qwen2.5-Math-7B regenerating MATH-500 problems from partial prompts; a separate DCR study reports GSM8K contamination for Qwen2.5-7B), and nobody has shown a test-set leak for the 72B model itself. Set it to true if you want a family-level reading. DeepSeek's V3 report lists SWE-bench Verified 23.8 for this model from DeepSeek's own run, not Qwen's, so swebench stays null. First-party API price at launch not verified, so api=false.

Derived from Qwen2.5-32B with 5.5T extra code-heavy tokens (the smaller 1.5B and 7B Coder models came out earlier, on 2024-09-18). Blog dated 2024-11-12. MMLU 79.1 is the base model (base HumanEval 65.9). HumanEval 92.7 (HE+ 87.2), MBPP 90.2, LiveCodeBench 31.4, BigCodeBench-Instruct 49.6, GSM8K 93.0, MATH 76.4 and MMLU 77.6 are for Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct (paper arXiv 2409.12186). Aider is 73.7 pass@2, described as comparable to GPT-4o. Apache 2.0. Compute 4.58e24 = Qwen2.5-32B base (Epoch 3.51e24) + the 5.5T code stage (Epoch 1.07e24), since the model is initialised from the base; Epoch's headline 1.07e24 counts only the code stage, which I changed to match how Coder-V2 is counted. Arena Elo is measured: qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 44). First-party API price at launch not verified, so api=false.

Open-weight reasoning model (o1-style chain of thought) built on Qwen2.5-32B, Apache 2.0. Blog dated 2024-11-28. Blog results: GPQA 65.2, AIME 2024 50.0, MATH-500 90.6, LiveCodeBench 50.0. No official MMLU, HumanEval or GSM8K. Compute is my estimate: the Qwen2.5-32B pretraining figure from Epoch (3.51e24 = 6 x 32.5B x 18T) plus negligible post-training; Epoch has no page for the Preview. Arena Elo is measured: qwq-32b-preview in the 2025-01-05 snapshot (rank 74, 3,420 votes). QVQ-72B-Preview (2024-12-25) is deliberately omitted as non-core.

caveats:
ARENA SNAPSHOT (same for every lab): Hugging Face dataset lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset, config 'text' (style control OFF), split 'full', category 'overall', leaderboard_publish_date 2025-01-05. Re-verified through the datasets-server /rows API: row_idx 1036379-1036532 (154 models). Anchors: o1-2024-12-17 1351.6, o1-preview 1335.1, deepseek-v3 1318.7, o1-mini 1306.3, gpt-4o-2024-05-13 1285.0, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 1283.5, claude-3-opus-20240229 1247.4, gpt-4-0613 1163.1, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 1105.8. Entries with arenaEstimated=true are interpolations, not measurements: DeepSeek Coder 33B, DeepSeekMoE 16B, DeepSeek-V2, R1-Lite-Preview, Qwen-7B and Qwen-72B. The snapshot has no entry for any of them. Measured values also exist for deepseek-v2.5-1210 (1279.1) and qwen1.5-110b-chat (1161.5) if you want to add those.

SCORE CONVENTIONS: MMLU is the 5-shot base-model figure where available. HumanEval and GSM8K are the chat or instruct variant where the lab reported one, otherwise base (each note says which). Squad and GLUE are null throughout. GPQA is filled only where the lab reported it (V2 35.3 and V2.5 41.3 from DeepSeek's V3 report, V3 59.1, Qwen2-72B 42.4, Qwen2.5-72B 49.0, QwQ-32B-Preview 65.2). Epoch's independent runs were not used as scores. SWE-bench: V3 42.0 and V2.5 22.6 are Verified; Coder-V2 12.7 is not Verified.

CHANGES FROM THE DRAFT: (1) DeepSeek-V3 humaneval 82.6 -> 65.2, because 82.6 is HumanEval-Mul (chat), not HumanEval; 65.2 is the base model's plain HumanEval, so V3 now looks lower than V2/V2.5 on that field, set it to null if you prefer. (2) DeepSeek-V2.5 gets mmlu 80.6, gpqa 41.3 and swebench 22.6 from DeepSeek's V3 report (the draft said no official numbers exist); V2 gets gpqa 35.3 from the same table. (3) Compute: Coder 33B 4.0e23 -> 3.96e23; V2 1.0e24 -> 1.02e24; Coder-V2 1.3e24 -> 1.29e24; V2.5 1.3e24 -> 1.79e24 (Epoch counts 14.2T unique tokens); LLM 67B 8.0e23 -> 8.04e23; Qwen-7B 1.0e23 -> 1.01e23; Qwen2-72B 3.0e24 -> 3.02e24; Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 1.1e24 -> 4.58e24 (base + code stage, because it is initialised from Qwen2.5-32B; Epoch's 1.07e24 is the code stage only). Epoch does have pages or rows for DeepSeekMoE 16B (3.4e22) and Qwen-72B (1.3e24, 2023-11-30), contrary to the draft. (4) Qwen-72B and Qwen1.5-72B are now api=true with first-party Alibaba Cloud DashScope prices from its 2024-03-11 billing notice (0.012 yuan/1K = $1.69 per 1M, and 0.02 yuan/1K = $2.78 per 1M); the draft had api=false and null prices. Launch-day availability is not verified, and the Qwen1.5 price starts 2024-03-18. (5) Qwen2.5-72B benchContaminationSuspected true -> false (no evidence specific to the 72B model). (6) Arena estimates revised: Coder 33B 1065 -> 1060; Qwen-72B 1110 -> 1115 (the draft's MT-Bench 8.35 for Qwen-72B-Chat could not be verified and was dropped); DeepSeekMoE and V2 rationale reworded. (7) Qwen2.5-72B swebench stays null even though DeepSeek's V3 report has 23.8 from its own run. (8) Notes and sources corrected (DeepSeekMoE and Qwen-72B Epoch claims, V2.5 and Qwen-72B date confirmations, Qwen-14B 'optional filler' wording).

NAMING: descriptor words changed to match the sibling catalogs (q1-previow in openbrain.json): Preview -> Previow, Lite -> Lito; ids updated (deepseak-r1-lito-previow, qwk-32b-previow). Brand tokens follow the fixed mappings (DeepSeak, Qwin, QwK); Coder, V2, R1, MoE and LLM are kept. Sibling openbrain.json takes its Arena values from mathewhe/chatbot-arena-elo tag 20250124; its anchors agree with this snapshot within about 1.3 points (o1-mini 1305 vs 1306.3), so the groups are comparable.

VERIFIED UNCHANGED: all release dates (Coder-V2 uses the 2024-06-17 paper and weights date; its API upgrade was 2024-06-14), parameter counts, every benchmark score not listed above, V2/Coder-V2/V2.5/V3 first-party price $0.14 / $0.28 (V2 and Coder-V2 launch prices are secondary-sourced: DeepSeek's old pricing pages could not be retrieved), and all measured arena values. DeepSeek LLM 67B, Coder 33B and DeepSeekMoE stay api=false because their first-party API at launch is unconfirmed; Qwen2/2.5/Coder/QwQ stay api=false for the same reason (they were certainly sold on third-party hosts). SCOPE: QVQ-72B-Preview, Qwen2-VL, Qwen1.5-110B, DeepSeek-Math, DeepSeek-VL, DeepSeek-V2.5-1210, Qwen-Max and Qwen2.5-Max (Jan 2025) remain out of scope.
